items.prompt: She said, "I am tired." → She said that she ___ tired.
items.explanation: Reporting a present-tense statement usually backshifts am → was.
Reported questions backshift and use statement word order.
Reported requests use ask + object + to-infinitive.

items.prompt: Complete with one word: "I'll call you," he said. → He said he ___ call me.
Report the question: "Where do you work?" he asked.
items.explanation: Reported wh-questions keep the question word, then use statement order and backshift.

items.prompt: Report the request: "Please help me," she said.
answers: She asked me to help her
items.explanation: Reported requests take ask + object + to-infinitive.
